# NoteAddScope

`schemas/api/scope/note-add.json`

The scope of note.add (docs/design/m0/08 notes): the project the note is bound to, an optional record it is about (unchecked: a reference, never resolved) and its body. The note's id, author and time are the controller's, never the request's.

|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | yes | [ProjectID](common-defs.md#projectid) |  |
| `subject` |  | [TypeID](common-defs.md#typeid) |  |
| `body` | yes | [NoteBody](common-defs.md#notebody) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
